narrative:
Brown County has 28,897 registered voters, with 56.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 10.8%, a pronounced Republican lean of 21.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.4% of registrants.
